intent.logline: In an interview room, a young officer slides a photograph across the table; the man opposite pushes it back with one finger.
intent.turn: the officer owns the room -> the suspect quietly owns the officer
intent.audience_knows: the photograph is not evidence against the suspect, it is evidence of him

shots.purpose: Hand the officer the initiative, and make the table a border.

emotion.contradiction: static camera for what should be a pressure scene

framing.notes: two-shot across the table, officer nearer camera

composition.value_masses: cold fluorescent bar above, pale table, two dark torsos meeting at the table edge
composition.focus: the photograph entering from the lower left
composition.negative_space: the blank wall behind the suspect

subjects.name: Officer
subjects.screen: left foreground, back partly to camera

camera.motivation: the room is a machine; nothing in it should look nervous
camera.end_frame: photograph sits under the officer's fingers mid-table
camera.turn_frame: the photograph comes to rest under the officer's fingers

action.primary: The officer slides the photograph across the table.
cues: two fingers flat on the print
action.subtext: He has rehearsed this move and believes it is winning.

sound.diegetic: paper sliding on laminate, ventilation, a chair creak

transition_out.matches: the suspect's eyes drop to the photograph

continuity: officer on screen left, suspect screen right

references.label: <Picture 1>
references.defines: the interview room: pale laminate table, two chairs, overhead fluorescent panel, no window

shots.purpose: Show that he recognises the photograph, and refuses to react.

framing.notes: his face fills the right two thirds, photograph edge at bottom left

composition.value_masses: lit forehead and cheekbones, eyes in shadow, dark wall behind
composition.focus: the eyes, then the photograph edge

subjects.name: Suspect
subjects.pose: still, hands flat on the table

camera.motivation: hold on the absence of a reaction
camera.end_frame: eyes lift to the officer, face unchanged
camera.turn_frame: his eyes lift from the photograph to the officer

light.key: overhead, eyes shadowed by the brow

action.primary: He looks at the photograph for a long beat, then lifts his eyes.
cues: thumb taps once on the table
action.subtext: He is not deciding whether to lie; he is deciding how much to enjoy this.

continuity: same shadow line across the eyes
bans: no reaction shot of the officer

shots.purpose: Deliver the reversal with the smallest possible gesture.

framing.notes: his face and one hand, the photograph in his fingers at the bottom edge

composition.value_masses: face lit from below by the table bounce, dark ceiling above, white print at the bottom edge
composition.negative_space: the dark band above his head

subjects.name: Suspect
subjects.pose: leans back, one finger on the print

staging.reversal_reason: the photograph physically travels back across the table; the reversal is the turn

camera.motivation: the reversal is spatial, not kinetic
camera.end_frame: the photograph back on the officer's side of the table
camera.turn_frame: the photograph reverses direction on the table

light.key: low table bounce plus overhead rim

action.primary: He smiles faintly and pushes the photograph back across the table.
action.subtext: He is returning the officer's own move, and letting him notice.

sound.diegetic: paper sliding back, a breath, chair shift

transition_out.matches: cut as the photograph stops moving

shots.purpose: Let the officer understand what just happened, without a line.

framing.notes: the officer left of centre, photograph in his foreground

composition.value_masses: lit face, dark foreground shoulder, the print a bright rectangle at the bottom

camera.motivation: he has stopped performing; the frame should too
camera.start_frame: the photograph arrives at his hand
camera.turn_frame: his hand stops above the print and withdraws

action.primary: He looks at the photograph, then at the empty chair opposite.
action.subtext: He is recalculating who is being interviewed.

continuity: photograph stays out of his hand

beats.name: establish
beats.goal: hand the initiative to the officer
beats.knowledge_change: the officer believes he is winning

beats.name: omen
beats.goal: show that the suspect recognises the photograph
beats.knowledge_change: the photograph means something to him

beats.name: turn
beats.knowledge_change: he is not the one being interviewed

beats.name: aftermath
beats.knowledge_change: the interview is over and he has lost it

rhythm.note: hold the table, quicken into the reversal, let the officer sit in it
